evidence: brief/hld.md Behavior 5: idle ~1%/h and each clip ~1%

evidence: evidence/renderer.json raccoon-label app.event rendered as “Animal · 1:10 AM”

evidence: brief/hld.md Behavior 2: motion-classifier supplies the label
